# Writes only a strictly higher quantized candidate. Dispatch is based on
# candidate equality, never on the real run score.
xar_write_record_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate > global_var:xa_old_record }
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 166600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_166600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 165600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_165600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 164600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_164600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 163600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_163600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 162600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_162600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 161600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_161600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 160600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_160600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 159600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_159600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 158600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_158600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 157600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_157600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 156600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_156600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 155600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_155600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 154600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_154600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 153600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_153600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 152600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_152600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 151600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_151600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 150600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_150600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 149600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_149600
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { global_var:xa_record_candidate = 148600 }
			set_global_variable = xar_hs_ge_148600

# Read-only ledger projection generated from THRESHOLDS.
# xa_ledger_* are temporary display values; this never writes record bits.
xar_prepare_ledger_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_score value = xar_current_score_value }
	set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_candidate value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_next value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = {
		name = xa_ledger_gap
		value = { value = 1 subtract = global_var:xa_ledger_score min = 0 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_at_cap value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:xa_ledger_score >= 166600 }
		set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_candidate value = 166600 }
		set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_next value = 166600 }
		set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_gap value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_at_cap value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:xa_ledger_score >= 165600 }
		set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_candidate value = 165600 }
		set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_next value = 166600 }
		set_global_variable = {
			name = xa_ledger_gap
			value = { value = 166600 subtract = global_var:xa_ledger_score min = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:xa_ledger_score >= 164600 }
		set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_candidate value = 164600 }
		set_global_variable = { name = xa_ledger_next value = 165600 }

# Lifespan purchase: +1 year expectancy per buy, 50 buys max.
xar_buy_lifespan_effect = {
	change_global_variable = {
		name = xa_lifespan_bought
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:xa_lifespan_bought = 1 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = xar_lifespan_01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:xa_lifespan_bought = 2 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = xar_lifespan_02 }
